title: Conditional Empirical Evidence <-> Attitude-Cloud Fact-Algebra Court

proof_summary: Unary position conditionals, position conjunctions, response-conditioned distributions, response+position conditionals, branch-conditioned distributions, and branch+response cotravel are all selections and aggregations over a respondent-bound empirical incidence relation when condition predicates and risk sets are typed.

Joint response patterns fit the same algebra by allowing a multivariate target tuple rather than forcing a scalar Y; exact respondent incidence or an information-equivalent full k-way contingency is still required according to the reconstruction task.

Historical V549 branch-conditioned cotravel fits the algebra when actual branch membership is represented as a derived cohort predicate or explicit membership relation with branch provenance; a branch ID alone is insufficient.

Current V550 attitude-cloud rows are composite: the directional event, candidate baseline, and symmetric association diagnostics use different denominator/risk-set definitions. A cloud row therefore cannot be identified with one generic P(Y|X) fact.

Association summaries such as NMI, Cramer's V, MI-like scores, lift, and entropy reduction are derived functionals over richer contingency/incidence facts and are non-invertible; they occupy a distinct derived-summary lane inside the algebra.
The algebra does not authorize any empirical statistic to become structural interpretation, generated actor position, actor belief, or developmental state. Those remain separate jurisdictions.

primitive_relations.name: RESPONSE_EVENT
primitive_relations.shape: Response(r, question_id, response_event_id, response_value, response_topology, typed_state, authority_ref, provenance_ref)
primitive_relations.note: response_event_id may be singular, set-valued, ordered, or repeated according to topology authority

primitive_relations.name: EMPIRICAL_POSITION_ATOM
primitive_relations.shape: Position(r, coordinate_id, coordinate_value, typed_state, authority_ref, provenance_ref)
primitive_relations.note: empirical survey coordinate only; not ADP-009 generated actor position

primitive_relations.name: ROUTING_APPLICABILITY_ATOM
primitive_relations.shape: Eligibility(r, question_id, applicability_state, routing_state, authority_ref, provenance_ref)
primitive_relations.note: separates observable risk set from substantive response content

primitive_relations.name: BRANCH_MEMBERSHIP
primitive_relations.note: derived from exact branch predicate/source incidence or stored explicit membership; branch label alone is insufficient

condition_predicate.grammar: AND/OR/NOT over typed empirical predicates bound to the same respondent variable where required

risk_set.rule: denominator eligibility is an explicit predicate independent of C(r)

target.multivariate_case: ordered or canonically set-valued tuple of governed response components
target.rule: joint-response configurations are not forced into a scalar response field

measure.weighted: mu_weighted(r)=governed survey weight when authorized and valid
measure.rule: raw and weighted measures are distinct; a percentage without measure/denominator basis is incomplete

fact_formula.numerator: N_m(t;S,C,R,T)=SUM_r mu_m(r) * 1[r in S AND R(r) AND C(r) AND T(r)=t]
fact_formula.denominator: D_m(S,C,R)=SUM_r mu_m(r) * 1[r in S AND R(r) AND C(r)]
fact_formula.distribution: the empirical fact is the complete governed target topology over all t plus N/D/support/limit state, not only a modal cell
fact_formula.zero_denominator: typed ZERO_SUPPORT / ZERO_OVERLAP / NOT_APPLICABLE / UNRESOLVED as appropriate; absence of a row is not sufficient semantics

must_include: condition predicate AST/hash and predicate types
fact_identity.same_answer_different_condition_rule: two equal numerical distributions under different branch or position predicates remain distinct empirical facts

admission_overlay.rule: empirical fact identity and downstream admissibility are separate
does_not_promote: empirical coordinate to generated actor position

equivalence_classes.E0_RESPONDENT_INCIDENCE: respondent-bound empirical observation relation; information generator
equivalence_classes.E0B_DERIVED_COHORT_INCIDENCE: exact branch/cohort membership relation derived from E0 plus branch law or retained explicitly
equivalence_classes.E1_CONDITIONAL_DISTRIBUTION: full target distribution under typed condition and typed risk set
equivalence_classes.E2_JOINT_OUTCOME_INCIDENCE: multivariate target pattern/configuration distribution under a common respondent/risk-set semantics
equivalence_classes.E3_DERIVED_COMPOSITE_VIEW: bundle/index selecting or comparing E1/E2 facts across possibly different risk sets
equivalence_classes.E4_DERIVED_ASSOCIATION_FUNCTIONAL: non-invertible scalar/vector functional over E1/E2 contingency facts

P(Y response | branch predicate B, scope)

component_1_directional_event.denominator: N_a in full prepared anchor frame

minimum_branch_identity: resolved predicate AST or explicit immutable membership set

observed_static_geometry: respondents are grouped by respondent_id across a configured family
raw pattern signatures concatenate component var_code=response_value pairs
semantic pattern signatures concatenate item_role=semantic_response_role pairs
identical respondent signatures are grouped into pattern counts/probabilities
pattern rows retain respondent_ids and a dedicated pattern_membership surface exists
association computation joins pattern membership to outside-family responses by respondent identity
association traces separately expose pattern member count, pattern-variable answered count, response overlap, baseline answered count, weighted/unweighted support, and denominator bases
fixed_pattern_counts_sufficient_for: incidence/probability of that exact configured pattern under its exact fixed risk set
fixed_pattern_counts_insufficient_for: association of pattern members with an unmaterialized outside variable
reconditioning pattern by a new position predicate
v550j_joint_geometry.multiselect_repeated_response_caveat: current scalar-duplicate and first-row behaviors are implementation evidence only; generic algebra must support topology-aware 0..n response events or type the topology unsupported

unary_conditionals.minimum_for_fixed_query: full condition-value x target-response contingency with exact denominator/risk-set, topology, raw support, weight basis, typed limit states, and provenance

pairwise_cotravel.minimum_for_fixed_pair: full same-respondent pair contingency plus exact anchor/candidate/common-risk-set counts required by the selected denominator law

arbitrary_conjunctions.minimum: respondent-level joint incidence or an information-equivalent exhaustive joint contingency over every governed variable/state that may enter the query

branch_conditioned_cotravel.minimum: exact branch membership relation or source incidence plus exact branch predicate/replay law, joined to target response incidence under exact risk-set semantics

joint_response_patterns.minimum_for_fixed_pattern_frequency: full configured k-way contingency with topology/routing/weights/provenance
joint_response_patterns.minimum_for_pattern_to_outside_associati: respondent membership/incidence for the pattern plus outside response incidence, or exact joint contingency including the outside variable

association_summaries.minimum_to_recompute: the full underlying contingency plus metric formula/version and measure basis

hostile_cases.result: PASS only at E0/E2 or exact conjunction E1 level; unary conditionals/scalar association rankings cannot reconstruct it
PASS only when stratifier and target/predictor joint incidence plus exact denominators survive; pooled marginals are insufficient
algebra preserves raw support and typed underpowered/admission state separately; low support may restrict use but cannot mean nonexistence
represented as a typed zero-overlap/common-risk-set state; not silently omitted and not assigned a fabricated conditional probability
routing/applicability belongs in R(r) and typed response state; anchor-selected and common-eligible denominators remain distinct alternatives
typed special states cannot silently enter substantive response topology; they may be queried only under explicit authority
scalar-one-row grammar is rejected; response event identity/set/order/repetition semantics must be retained or the topology is typed unsupported
conjunction predicate can contain multiple simultaneous empirical position atoms without selecting a dominant identity; no actor inference follows

hostile_cases.case: same answer under different branch predicates
hostile_cases.result: distinct fact identities because branch predicate/provenance hashes differ even if numerical distributions match

hostile_cases.case: same answer under different position predicates
hostile_cases.result: distinct fact identities because condition predicates differ even if numerical distributions match

hostile_cases.case: same marginals different respondent-level joint incidence
hostile_cases.result: marginals fail; e.g. a 50/50-by-50/50 independent 2x2 table and a perfectly concordant 50/50 table have identical marginals but different cotravel

hostile_cases.case: asymmetric conditional probabilities with symmetric association scores
hostile_cases.result: PASS because ordered E1 conditional facts and E4 symmetric functionals are separate; Cramer's V/NMI equality does not imply P(B|A)=P(A|B)

network_cloud_ruling.reason: a cloud may select, rank, or network conditional/joint facts, but current V550 persistence discards joint cells and mixes risk sets; its information can be regenerated only from deeper pair incidence/contingency plus exact selection/metric law

mandatory_noncollapse.empirical_response: observed response event/value under topology authority
mandatory_noncollapse.structural_interpretation: later governed interpretation; not created by algebra
mandatory_noncollapse.question_relation: semantic/admission authority about a question; not a respondent observation
mandatory_noncollapse.branch_membership: derived respondent cohort relation with exact provenance
mandatory_noncollapse.population_distribution: aggregate measure over a typed risk set
mandatory_noncollapse.diagnostic_association_score: derived functional; not distribution or causal relation
mandatory_noncollapse.actor_position: generated actor-specific fact outside empirical survey algebra unless later exact cross-ontology authority binds it
mandatory_noncollapse.actor_belief: actor-specific state; never inferred directly from population conditional
